review: Screenshots opened and individually inspected; defects repaired and replacement captures inspected.

states.desktop: pass — full globe and geographic outlines visible; controls, units, period, uncertainty and legend are legible; desktop panes intentionally scroll.
states.flat-anomaly: pass — opaque heading and footer retain contrast against the anomaly field; anomaly year and regional trend interval are distinct.
states.coverage: pass — coverage scale, country boundaries, legend and period are visible.
states.regional-annual-record: pass — expanded, scrolled table has readable year/anomaly headers and signed observed values.
states.methods: pass — ordered method sections and scrollable modal; normal-approximation and multiplicity limitations stated.
states.provenance: pass — record extent, baseline, smoothing, file history and wrapping SHA are readable.
states.regional-no-data: pass — selected bounds and explicit insufficient-footprint message; no fabricated result.
states.mobile: pass — 390px layout has no horizontal overflow; legend is separated from attribution; controls and inspector stack in reading order.
states.mobile-methods: pass — repaired 366px dialog fits a 390px viewport; close control visible; text/math wrap with vertical scrolling.

scope: Visual/UI validation is not scientific peer review.
